model: GPT-5 family (exact deployed snapshot not exposed)
purpose: Implement and verify storage-budgeted SQLite index selection on a reproducible synthetic database

revisions.reason: The first direct calibration command omitted the repository src path
revisions.action: Reran through the supported Python path and retained the failure in logs/failures.md

revisions.reason: A 100-page preliminary budget admitted only a weak one-index solution
revisions.action: Fixed the final documented budget at 180 measured pages so meaningful two-index alternatives compete

revisions.reason: Whole-workload candidate timing could credit unrelated query noise
revisions.action: Restricted benefit to plan-confirmed query use and increased estimation repetitions

revisions.reason: The original query mix did not reliably distinguish greedy from exact selection
revisions.action: Documented a read-heavy storefront mix with catalog weight 200 before retaining final results

notes: Only observed work and failures are recorded. The data are synthetic, timings are local warm-cache SQLite measurements, and SQLite's internal optimizer was not replaced.
